title: NWG-DETR: grid-line-aware wavelet-gated RT-DETR for photovoltaic electroluminescence defect detection
mechanism: Dark-contrast gating, cross-polarisation gating that attenuates repetitive grid-line artefacts, and learnable wavelet pool/unpool that keeps high-frequency defect detail.
adaptation: Take the learnable wavelet pool for the U-Net++ stem and unpool for the decoder, and the grid-line gate on the two highest-resolution skips; detector parts discarded.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + learnable wavelet pool + grid-line skip gate; baseline PF; kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02. Only after Seg-Aliasing or HWD passes.
evidence: R: PVEL-AD mAP50 +3.77 over RT-DETR-r18, 45% fewer parameters.

alt_notes.adaptation: Replace the ResNet-34 stem max-pool and first stride with Haar wavelet downsampling (keep LH/HL/HH as channels) so 1 to 2 px cracks survive the 4x stem; gate using our own predicted gridline / busbar maps.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with wavelet stem. Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metric: crack components >= 20 px found, crack IoU. Kill if components found gain < 0.02.
